user.title: Battery and equipment
user.description: Select the battery readings and installed equipment.

data.usable_soc: SoC is scaled to the usable range

data_description.capacity_kwh: Rated capacity in kWh. A selected sensor takes precedence.
data_description.backup_percent: Used when no reserve sensor is selected.
data_description.usable_soc: Enable for Sungrow readings scaled between the configured minimum and maximum SoC. Disable for an absolute reading.

consumption.title: Energy meters
consumption.description: Select cumulative energy meters. If configured, EV charging must be included in the measured household load before subtraction.

planning.title: Forecast and charge planning
planning.description: Select forecast sources and when grid charging can run.

data.low_pv_kwh: PV threshold for a full charge

data_description.pv_today: The sensor must provide the detailedHourly attribute.
data_description.end_time: The window starts at midnight. Enter the end time in whole minutes.
data_description.fallback_load_kw: Estimated average household load for hours without sufficient learning data.

operation.title: Operating mode
operation.description: Preview mode calculates the plan. Active control requires compatible inverter entities.

controls.title: Inverter control
controls.description: Select the writable controls and actual inverter feedback entities. Mode labels must match the controls and the reported values.

data_description.interlock_automation: Active control is blocked unless the selected automation reports that it is off.

error.invalid_time: Choose a whole-minute end time after midnight.
